name: Bredenbek (Germany)
description: Red field with a broad white wavy bend bearing a blue wavy stripe, the figure of the municipal arms of Bredenbek.
history: Municipal flag of Bredenbek; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: blue wavy stripe within the bend
